subject: [ACTION REQUIRED] DGA Provisional Identity Registration & Verification

attachments.name: CITIZEN_REGISTRATION_FORM.osform
attachments.previewText:
APPLICANT ID: #DGA-PROV-99410
ISSUING AUTHORITY: Digital Governance Agency (DGA)
REQUIREMENT: Verify identity biometrics to unlock full Civic Profile & OS Clearance Level 1.

body:
Official Dispatch from the Digital Governance Agency (DGA):

Welcome, provisional citizen.

Your temporary MIRAVERSEOSX network key has been logged. Under DGA Directive 14-B, all new assets must verify their citizen biometrics before full OS clearance and Civic Profile features are granted.

Open the attached registration form below to complete your identity registration. Once verified, your Civic Profile will be unlocked and you will be directed to schedule your mandatory Faith Medical baseline scan.

subject: Welcome to MIRAVERSEOSX

attachments.name: CITIZEN_REGISTRATION_FORM.osform
attachments.previewText: Confirms provisional resident record and unlocks basic integration tasks.

body:
Welcome, citizen.

Your provisional MIRAVERSEOSX registration has been received. Your record currently contains no verified credits, no active contacts, no declared career track, and no permanent housing. This is expected. MIRAVERSEOSX begins from a clean state so every player builds their identity through choices, work, study, relationships, and discovery.

subject: Your Temporary Login Credentials

attachments.name: STARTER_ACCESS_MANIFEST.pdf
attachments.previewText: Shows which municipal apps are unlocked at start and which are locked behind civic progression.

body: Temporary access has been generated for player. You are logged into MIRAVERSEOSX under a default asset key. Please review the attached Starter Access Manifest to inspect unlocked applications.

subject: Housing Assignment: Unit Access Pending

attachments.name: HOUSING_TEMP_ASSIGNMENT.form
attachments.previewText: Confirms starter apartment, empty room state, storage limit, and property upgrade requirements.

body: Player has been assigned a starter dorm unit in Block A (North Wing). You do not own permanent property. Access the attached Housing Assignment Form to review storage limits and property requirements.

subject: Citizen Record Activation Required

attachments.name: CITIZEN_RECORD_ACTIVATION.osform
attachments.previewText: Activates identity, residence, employment status, and blank aura record fields.

body: Player’s Civic Profile requires record activation. Please complete the attached Citizen Record Activation form to confirm your residence and employment preferences.

subject: Faith Medical Portal Registration

attachments.name: FAITH_PATIENT_INTAKE.osform
attachments.previewText: Creates the player’s basic medical profile and unlocks first intake appointment task.

body: Faith Medical Group has generated an intake checkup record for player. Please complete the attached Faith Patient Intake form to establish your baseline health record.

subject: Communications Setup Notice

attachments.name: COMMUNICATIONS_QUICKSTART.pdf
attachments.previewText: Explains Phone, Comms, Mail, ChatMeet, and Pulse from an in-world perspective.

body: Player currently has no saved contacts. Review the attached Communications Quickstart Guide to understand Comms channels, Direct Links, and DGA network monitoring.

subject: Notice Board Access Granted

attachments.name: NOTICE_BOARD_GUIDE.pdf
attachments.previewText: Explains Journey, Adventures, Quests, Tasks, and City Missions.

body: Your provisional account has been granted access to the Cyacademy & Municipal Notice Board. Review the attached Notice Board Guide to accept student tasks and city contracts.

subject: Integration Schedule: Day One

attachments.name: DAY_ONE_INTEGRATION_SCHEDULE.ics
attachments.previewText: Adds the first day schedule to Calendar/ChatMeet and creates starter objectives.

body: Player, welcome. Review the attached Day One Integration Schedule, complete your preliminary tasks, and maintain awareness of network anomalies.

subject: District Placement Notice

attachments.name: DISTRICT_PLACEMENT_SURVEY.osform
attachments.previewText: Allows district sorting or confirmation and assigns initial neighborhood flavor.

attachments.name: FOUR_DISTRICTS_OVERVIEW.pdf
attachments.previewText: Overview of Glassline District, Sub-Aureline, Old Factory Ward, and Lumen Market.

body: Player has not yet confirmed a District affiliation. District placement affects your housing block, early social flavor, minor starting bonuses, and first-week events. Complete the attached survey to begin placement review.

subject: Starter Credits Ledger

attachments.name: ZERO_BALANCE_LEDGER.pdf
attachments.previewText: Confirms the player begins with 0 credits and must earn income through tasks and contracts.

attachments.name: CREDIT_EARNING_GUIDE.pdf
attachments.previewText: Explains income from quests, job shifts, software publishing, and city contracts.

body: Player’s financial ledger has been created with a beginning balance of 0 Credits. This is standard for new provisional records. Credits may be earned through tasks, quests, job missions, software publishing, event rewards, and approved civic contracts.

subject: Required Forms Still Incomplete

attachments.name: REQUIRED_FORMS_CHECKLIST.pdf
attachments.previewText: Checklist of missing items: Citizen Record, housing, district, Faith Medical intake.

body: Player has several incomplete onboarding forms. Required forms must be completed before full municipal services unlock. Missing items may include Citizen Record activation, housing confirmation, district placement, Faith Medical intake, and communications agreement.

subject: Emergency Contact Registration

attachments.name: EMERGENCY_CONTACT_FORM.osform
attachments.previewText: Register emergency response routing contacts.

attachments.name: CITY_SAFETY_PROTOCOLS.pdf
attachments.previewText: Emergency response protocols for Civil Safety, Faith Medical, and DGA liaison.

body: Player currently has no emergency contacts on file. Until contacts are added, automated response routing will default to Civil Safety, Faith Medical Group, and DGA municipal liaison services.

subject: Acceptable Use Agreement

attachments.name: ACCEPTABLE_USE_AGREEMENT.osform
attachments.previewText: Terms of network access and prohibited restricted folder access.

attachments.name: DATA_BLEED_REPORTING_RULES.pdf
attachments.previewText: Mandatory protocols for reporting unencrypted data bleeds and PRISM threats.

body: Player must acknowledge MIRAVERSEOSX acceptable use terms before advanced civic access is granted. Unauthorized access to restricted folders, encrypted sectors, Old Factory Ward nodes, DGA files, and Faith Medical records may result in warnings, lockouts, or investigation flags.

subject: Phone Number Reserved

attachments.name: PHONE_STARTER_PLAN.pdf
attachments.previewText: Confirms temporary mobile number reservation and calling/texting terms.

body: A temporary phone number has been reserved for the player. Calling, texting, voicemail, photos, contacts, and emergency dialing will activate after the player confirms the Phone Starter Plan.

subject: ChatMeet Integration Invitation

attachments.name: DAY_ONE_INTEGRATION_SCHEDULE.ics
attachments.previewText: Assembly schedule for ChatMeet Day One Session.

attachments.name: CHATMEET_ACCESS_TOKEN.key
attachments.previewText: Token key for entering Day One Integration assembly room.

body: Player has been invited to the Day One Integration session through ChatMeet. Attendance confirms schedule access and unlocks additional onboarding tasks.

subject: Pulse Account Creation Pending

attachments.name: PULSE_COMMUNITY_GUIDELINES.pdf
attachments.previewText: Guidelines for public posting, reputation tracking, and district trend participation.

body: Player does not yet have a public Pulse profile. Profile creation is optional during Day One but required for social posting, public reputation tracking, district announcements, trend participation, and city event visibility.
